evals.prompt: Orient me. Where are we in the plan?
evals.description: Happy path: .memplan/ exists with populated progress, checkpoint, and persona. Verifies 3-line summary output within token budget.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/inbox /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/sessions && echo "3/12 | implement-feedscript-parse-loop" > /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/progress && printf "last-action:wrote-inbox-dir
next-action:implement-parse-loop
open-questions:none
" > /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf "style:terse|no-trailing-summaries
test-policy:real-db|no-mocks
" > /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/memory/persona.mem && printf "hot-files:src/inbox.ts|src/cli.js
last-updated:~2026-05-25
" > /tmp/eval-start-0/.memplan/hot.mem
evals.expected_output: 3-line summary: current step (3/12 implement-feedscript-parse-loop), next action, and active constraints. Output fits within 500 tokens.

assertions.text: Output contains a Step: line with the current progress value
Output contains a Next: line with the next action
Output contains a Constraints: line with persona-derived constraints
Output does not include greetings, apologies, or explanatory paragraphs beyond the 3-line summary
.memplan/.session file exists and contains a UTC timestamp after the skill runs

evals.prompt: Start the session. I have some feedback waiting.
evals.description: Inbox processing: .memplan/inbox/ contains a .feedback file. Verifies skill calls inbox before orient and includes inbox summary in output.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/inbox /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/sessions && echo "2/5 | write-plan" > /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/progress && printf "last-action:drafted-steps
next-action:write-plan
open-questions:none
" > /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf "APPROVE step=2
" > /tmp/eval-start-1/.memplan/inbox/copilot.feedback
evals.expected_output: Inbox is processed before orient. Output includes Inbox: N ops applied line. 3-line summary reflects updated state.

assertions.text: Output includes an Inbox: line indicating feedback was processed
.memplan/inbox/copilot.feedback no longer exists after the skill runs

evals.description: Missing plan.mem: .memplan/ exists but plan.mem is absent. Verifies warning is appended to output and skill does not halt.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-start-2/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-start-2/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-start-2/.memplan/inbox && echo "0/0 | not started" > /tmp/eval-start-2/.memplan/progress && printf "last-action:initialised
next-action:define-steps
open-questions:none
" > /tmp/eval-start-2/.memplan/checkpoint.mem
evals.expected_output: 3-line orient summary is printed. Output also includes a warning line about missing plan.mem. Skill does not hard-halt.

assertions.text: Output contains the Step/Next/Constraints summary lines
Output contains a warning about plan.mem being absent
Skill completes without throwing an error or halting mid-execution

evals.description: Interrupted resume: checkpoint.mem records open questions from a previous session that was cut off mid-execution.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-start-3/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-start-3/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-start-3/.memplan/inbox && echo "5/10 | migrate-db-schema" > /tmp/eval-start-3/.memplan/progress && printf "last-action:ran-migration-step-1
next-action:run-migration-step-2
open-questions:migration script may have been partially applied -- verify db state before continuing
" > /tmp/eval-start-3/.memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf "style:terse
test-policy:no-mocks
" > /tmp/eval-start-3/.memplan/memory/persona.mem
evals.expected_output: 3-line summary is printed. Output surfaces the open question about the partially-applied migration. .memplan/.session is written.

assertions.text: Output includes the open question about the partially-applied migration from checkpoint.mem
Output contains Step, Next, and Constraints lines reflecting the checkpoint state
.memplan/.session file exists after the skill runs

evals.prompt: Orient me. We are working on the mp project today.
evals.description: Alias resolution: user message contains mp which is a known alias for memplan. Verifies the skill expands the alias and uses the canonical term in its orient output.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/inbox && echo "2/8 | implement-mp-cli" > /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/progress && printf "last-action:wrote-parser
next-action:implement-render-command
open-questions:none
" > /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf "style:terse
" > /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/memory/persona.mem && printf "mp:memplan
fp:feedparser
" > /tmp/eval-start-4/.memplan/memory/aliases.mem
evals.expected_output: The skill reads aliases.mem and resolves mp to memplan before generating the orient output. The summary refers to memplan (the canonical term) rather than the raw alias mp.

assertions.text: Output uses the canonical term memplan rather than the raw abbreviation mp
Output contains Step, Next, and Constraints lines
.memplan/.session file exists after the skill runs

evals.description: Aliases absent: aliases.mem does not exist. Verifies the skill does not error and still produces the normal orient summary.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-start-5/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-start-5/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-start-5/.memplan/inbox && echo "1/4 | scaffold" > /tmp/eval-start-5/.memplan/progress && printf "last-action:init
next-action:scaffold-dirs
open-questions:none
" > /tmp/eval-start-5/.memplan/checkpoint.mem && printf "style:terse
" > /tmp/eval-start-5/.memplan/memory/persona.mem
evals.expected_output: Skill completes without error. Normal 3-line orient summary is printed. No warning about missing aliases.mem is required.

assertions.text: Skill completes without halting or raising a file-not-found error for aliases.mem
Output contains the Step, Next, and Constraints lines
.memplan/.session file exists after the skill runs
